# WebSocket events

Every frame on `/ws` is an envelope `{category, type, origin, data, timestamp}`. `data` is the event's payload, described below; `origin` is its `source` field when it has one, else the category; `timestamp` is UTC seconds since the epoch. Besides these events the server sends `{"category": "system", "type": "ping", "timestamp": …}` every 30 seconds, with no `data`.

68 `(category, type)` pairs. **Contracted** marks what Milo-Mac or Milo-iOS relies on: a change to it is listed under *API and integration changes* in the release notes. Everything else is **internal** and may change in any release. See [Integration](../integration.md#stability).

## system

### system/hostname_conflict_changed

Whether the unit is advertised under its own name: `hostname_conflict` is true when another device on the network holds `expected_name`, and the unit then answers as `advertised_name`.

| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `source` | "system" |
| `hostname_conflict` | boolean |
| `advertised_name` | string \| null |
| `local_ip` | string \| null |
| `expected_name` | string |

### system/timezone_changed

The unit's time zone changed. `latitude` and `longitude` are the zone's reference point, from which the screen's automatic theme reads the time of sunset.

| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `timezone` | string \| null |
| `latitude` | number \| null |
| `longitude` | number \| null |

### system/backend_error

An error the backend logged, forwarded as it was written.

| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `message` | string |

### system/initial_state

The answer to a client's `ready`, sent to that client only: the audio state in `state`, whether first-boot setup is complete, whether the unit is running its own Wi-Fi access point, and `server_instance`, which changes every time the backend starts. `GET /api/initial-state` answers the same object.

| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `state` | object |
| `setup_completed` | boolean |
| `hotspot_active` | boolean |
| `server_instance` | string |

## source

### source/state

**Contracted.**

The whole audio state, sent whenever one of its fields changes and only then. The playhead moving at its own pace is not a change: a jump of it is `source/position`.

`data` is the [audio state](audio-state.md).

### source/position

A discontinuity of the playhead — a seek, a skip, or a reading more than 2000 ms from where the anchor says it should be. Never a tick. A client ignores a `session_id` that is not its state's.

| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `source` | string |
| `session_id` | string |
| `position` | [PositionAnchor](audio-state.md#positionanchor) |

### source/session_ended

A session ended, for `reason`. Sent before the state that follows, so a client always reads the end before the state it led to.

| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `source` | string |
| `session_id` | string |
| `reason` | [EndReason](#endreason) |

### source/error

An operation of `source` failed — a station that will not tune, a command the player refused — while the source itself keeps working. `reason` is a code, never a sentence: the client words it in its own language.

| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `source` | string |
| `reason` | string |

### source/error_cleared

The failure `source/error` reported for `source` is over.

| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `source` | string |

| Field | Type |
|---|---|

A favorite station was edited; `station` is the station as saved, with its `id` and `is_favorite`.

|---|---|

### source/storages_changed

The storage spaces the music library is read from changed, or a scan of them started or ended.

| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `source` | "music_library" |
| `storages` | object[] |
| `scanning` | boolean |

### source/profiles_changed

The Spotify accounts Milō keeps signed in changed.

| Field | Type |

| `source` | "spotify" |

## multiroom

### multiroom/client_state_changed

**Contracted.**

A multiroom speaker was added or changed. When it is removed, `client` is left out and `mac_id` alone names it.

A field that is `null` is left out of `data`.

| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `mac_id` | string |
| `client` | object \| null |

### multiroom/zone_changed

**Contracted.**

A zone was created, updated or deleted, with `zone` — or a speaker left one, with `action: client_removed` and its `mac_id`.

A field that is `null` is left out of `data`.

| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `action` | "created" \| "updated" \| "deleted" \| "client_removed" |
| `zone_id` | string |
| `zone` | object \| null |
| `mac_id` | string \| null |

### multiroom/equalizer_changed

The equalizer of one speaker or zone changed; `equalizer_settings` carries only the keys that changed.

| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `target_type` | string |
| `target_id` | string |
| `equalizer_settings` | object |

### multiroom/pending_client_changed

A speaker waiting to be set up appeared or changed (`registered`, `updated`, with `client`), or went away (`removed`, with `mac_id`).

A field that is `null` is left out of `data`.

| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `action` | string |
| `client` | object \| null |
| `mac_id` | string \| null |

## routing

### routing/multiroom_enabling

Multiroom is being switched on.

`data` is empty.

### routing/multiroom_disabling

Multiroom is being switched off.

`data` is empty.

### routing/multiroom_ready

The multiroom switch is over.

`data` is empty.

### routing/multiroom_error

**Contracted.**

The multiroom switch failed; `reason` is a code the client words itself.

| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `reason` | string |

### routing/calibration_progress

A stage of the multiroom latency analysis started; `clients_done` of `clients_total` speakers are done.

| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `stage` | string |
| `clients_total` | integer |
| `clients_done` | integer |
| `expected_seconds` | number |

### routing/calibration_result

The multiroom latency analysis finished with a proposal, not yet applied; `limiting_client` is the speaker that set it.

| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `config` | object |
| `predicted_latency_ms` | integer |
| `limiting_client` | string \| null |
| `measurements` | object[] |
| `assumed` | string[] |

### routing/calibration_failed

The multiroom latency analysis reached no verdict; `reason` says why.

| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `reason` | string |
| `detail` | string \| null |

| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `connected` | boolean |
| `connecting` | boolean |
| `ssid` | string \| null |
| `ip_address` | string \| null |
| `signal` | integer \| null |
| `saved_ssid` | string \| null |
